The following events took place in '''980 BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]], [[mining caste]] leader [[Gelba]], and five other [[Mining/Legends|miners]] are [[Massacre on Doan|assassinated]].<ref name="doe" />
*[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|finds]] the [[Holocron of Heresies|long lost holocron]] of [[Darth Andeddu]].<ref name="doe" />
*[[Set Harth]] [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|becomes]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="doe" />
*[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] hires [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] Darth Bane.<ref name="doe" />
*Set Harth steals Darth Andeddu's holocron and learns the power of [[essence transfer]].<ref name="doe" />
*Darth Bane and Darth Zannah engage in their [[Duel on Doan|first duel]].<ref name="doe" />
*The Huntress submits herself to Darth Bane's teachings, taking the title Darth Cognus.<ref name="doe" />
*Darth Zannah defeats Darth Bane in a [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|duel]], taking the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="doe" />
*Darth Cognus becomes Darth Zannah's apprentice.<ref name="doe" />
